facts.fact: ANDE's 'Cadre et Référentiels' page lists, among four referentials it publishes for state information systems, 'Normes Procédures Règles d'Interopérabilité des SI' version 0.2.2, standards and rules for the interoperability of government information systems; the page gives no description of what they cover, and the date is the page's 2026 footer year (document published date, year precision).
facts.system: Normes Procédures Règles d'Interopérabilité des SI v0.2.2

note: No fact on use: the page names no law making the standards compulsory and no body tested or audited against them. The other three referentials (government domain registration, data security, source code management) are not exchange standards.

systems.owner: Government of Guinea with World Bank/ECOWAS WURI program

note: World Bank ISR on the WURI ID programme; states no technical standards for government data exchange (only ECOWAS fID interoperability strategy and biometric quality standards).
Border biometric system; no technical standards for government systems stated.
Tax system presentation; no technical standards for data exchange stated.
Decree on the national standards body IGNM covers product and quality standards and metrology, not technical standards for government systems to exchange data.
Register entry gives title and date only: a certification referential for electronic-transaction networks and systems (security/certification, one function); no text on data exchange standards.
